notes.title: The first post-launch update is live! (v1.0.16)
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where customers would disappear
[*] Fixed incorrect particle positions on broken machines
[*] Fixed issue where customers could use the prize wheel without an attendant
[*] Adjusted prices for Marketing actions
[/list]

We appreciate the community feedback and will continue working to make this a bigger and more enjoyable game. New content is coming soon…
